- The other position is from Tuesday through Saturday, totaling 15 hours per week.

- A smartphone that you can use during work for communication and route planning
- A sturdy bicycle with a metal luggage rack
- Availability for 3 hours per day, either in the morning or afternoon
- Flexibility to agree on a suitable work schedule together with your supervisor or team

If you enjoy working independently, spending time outdoors, and staying active, this could be the perfect job for you!
